entries.name: Alert
entries.description: _Origin Feat_ You gain the following benefits. _Initiative Proficiency._ When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll. _Initiative Swap._ Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the Incapacitated condition.

entries.name: Magic Initiate
entries.description: _Origin Feat_ You gain the following benefits. _Two Cantrips._ You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat). _Level 1 Spell._ Choose a level 1 spell from the same list you selected for this feat's cantrips. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way whe

entries.name: Savage Attacker
entries.description: _Origin Feat_ You've trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

entries.name: Skilled
entries.description: _Origin Feat_ You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice. _Repeatable._ You can take this feat more than once. ### General Feats

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. This feat can't increase an ability score above 20. _Repeatable._ You can take this feat more than once.

entries.name: Grappler
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+)_ You gain the following benefits. _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. _Punch and Grab._ When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use both the Damage and the Grapple option. You can use this benefit only once per turn. _Attack Advantage._ You have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature Grappled by you. _Fast Wres

entries.name: Archery
entries.description: _Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature)_ You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

entries.name: Defense
entries.description: _Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature)_ While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

entries.name: Great Weapon Fighting
entries.description: _Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature)_ When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property to gain this benefit.

entries.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
entries.description: _Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature)_ When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if you aren't already adding it to the damage. ### Epic Boon Feats

entries.name: Druidic Warrior
entries.description: _Fighting Style Feat (Ranger)_ You learn two Druid cantrips of your choice. The chosen cantrips count as Ranger spells for you, and Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a Ranger level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Druid cantrip.

entries.name: Blessed Warrior
entries.description: _Fighting Style Feat (Paladin)_ You learn two Cleric cantrips of your choice. The chosen cantrips count as Paladin spells for you, and Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a Paladin level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Cleric cantrip.

entries.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
entries.description: _Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)_ You gain the following benefits. _Ability Score Increase._ Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. _Peerless Aim._ When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
entries.description: _Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)_ You gain the following benefits. _Ability Score Increase._ Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. _Blink Steps._ Immediately after you take the Attack action or the Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

entries.name: Boon of Fate
entries.description: _Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)_ You gain the following benefits. _Ability Score Increase._ Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. _Improve Fate._ When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

entries.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
entries.description: _Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)_ You gain the following benefits. _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 30. _Overcome Defenses._ The Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal always ignores Resistance. _Overwhelming Strike._ When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to the ability score increased by this feat. The extra damage's type is the same as the attack's type.

entries.name: Boon of Spell Recall
entries.description: _Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+, Spellcasting Feature)_ You gain the following benefits. _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. _Free Casting._ Whenever you cast a spell with a level 1–4 spell slot, roll 1d4. If the number you roll is the same as the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.

entries.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
entries.description: _Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)_ You gain the following benefits. _Ability Score Increase._ Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. _Merge with Shadows._ While within Dim Light or Darkness, you can give yourself the Invisible condition as a Bonus Action. The condition ends on you immediately after you take an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction. _Shadowy Form._ While within Dim Light or Darkness, you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant

entries.name: Boon of Truesight
entries.description: _Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)_ You gain the following benefits. _Ability Score Increase._ Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. _Truesight._ You have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Crafter
entries.description: _Origin Feat_ You gain proficiency with three artisan tools of your choice. You buy nonmagical items at 80% price. During a Long Rest you can craft one nonmagical item or consumable at half the usual gold cost.

entries.name: Healer
entries.description: _Origin Feat_ As an Action, expend one use of a Healer's Kit to restore 1d4 + 1 + your Proficiency Bonus hit points to a creature. When you heal with a spell or this feat, reroll any heal die that shows a 1.

entries.name: Lucky
entries.description: _Origin Feat_ You have Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus (regain on a Long Rest). Spend 1 point to gain Advantage on an attack, ability check, or saving throw, or to impose Disadvantage on an attack against you.

entries.name: Musician
entries.description: _Origin Feat_ You gain proficiency with three musical instruments. After a Short or Long Rest, you may grant Heroic Inspiration to a number of allies up to your Proficiency Bonus.

entries.name: Tavern Brawler
entries.description: _Origin Feat_ Your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 + Strength bludgeoning. Once per turn when you hit with an Unarmed Strike, you may also push the target 5 feet. Reroll any 1 on Unarmed or improvised weapon damage dice.

entries.name: Tough
entries.description: _Origin Feat_ Your hit point maximum increases by twice your level. When you gain a level, you gain 2 additional hit points.

entries.name: Dueling
entries.description: _Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature)_ When you are wielding a Melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

entries.name: Protection
entries.description: _Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature)_ When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the attack roll. You must be wielding a Shield.

entries.name: Actor
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase your Charisma by 1. You have Advantage on Deception and Performance checks to pass yourself off as someone else, and you can mimic speech.

entries.name: Athlete
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1. Climbing speed equals your Speed. Standing from Prone costs only 5 feet. You need only 5 feet of run-up to jump.

entries.name: Charger
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1. When you Dash, your Speed increases by 10 feet for that move. If you move at least 10 feet straight toward a target and hit it with a melee attack, add 1d8 damage or push it 10 feet.

entries.name: Crossbow Expert
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Dexterity by 1. You ignore the Loading property of crossbows. Being within 5 feet of an enemy does not impose Disadvantage on your ranged attacks. When you attack with a one-handed crossbow, you can make one extra crossbow attack as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Dual Wielder
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1. You can Two-Weapon Fight with weapons that lack the Light property (but not Two-Handed). After the Attack action with a Light weapon, you can make one Bonus Action attack with another weapon.

entries.name: Great Weapon Master
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength by 1. When you hit with a Heavy weapon, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage. When you score a Critical Hit or reduce a creature to 0 HP with a melee weapon, you can make one melee attack as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Heavily Armored
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength or Constitution by 1. You gain proficiency with Heavy armor.

entries.name: Heavy Armor Master
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength or Constitution by 1. While wearing Heavy armor, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you take is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.

entries.name: Mounted Combatant
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom by 1. While mounted, you have Advantage on melee attacks against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount, can redirect attacks targeting the mount to yourself, and your mount has Evasion on Dexterity saves.

entries.name: Polearm Master
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1. When you take the Attack action with a Quarterstaff, Spear, Glaive, or Halberd, you can make a Bonus Action butt attack (1d4 bludgeoning). Creatures provoke Opportunity Attacks when they enter your reach with those weapons.

entries.name: Resilient
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase one ability score by 1 and gain proficiency in saving throws using that ability.

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1. When you hit with an Opportunity Attack, the target's Speed becomes 0. Creatures provoke Opportunity Attacks even if they Disengage. If an enemy within 5 feet attacks an ally, you can make a melee attack against that enemy as a Reaction.

entries.name: Sharpshooter
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Dexterity by 1. Attacking at long range does not impose Disadvantage. Your ranged weapon attacks ignore Half and Three-Quarters cover. Being within 5 feet of an enemy does not impose Disadvantage on your ranged attacks.

entries.name: Shield Master
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength by 1. If you hit with a melee attack while wielding a Shield, you can Bonus Action shove (push or prone; target Strength save). If you succeed on a Dexterity save that would halve damage, you can take a Reaction to take no damage instead.

entries.name: Speedy
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Dexterity or Constitution by 1. Your Speed increases by 10 feet. Difficult terrain does not slow you when you Dash. Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

entries.name: War Caster
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1. You have Advantage on Constitution saves to maintain Concentration. You can perform somatic components with weapons or a shield in hand. When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from you, you can cast a single-target spell as the Reaction instead.

entries.name: Spell Sniper
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1. Double the range of spells that require an attack roll. Your ranged spell attacks ignore Half and Three-Quarters cover. You learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll.

entries.name: Fey Touched
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1. You learn Misty Step and one 1st-level Enchantment or Illusion spell. You can cast each once without a slot per Long Rest.

entries.name: Shadow Touched
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1. You learn Invisibility and one 1st-level Illusion or Necromancy spell. You can cast each once without a slot per Long Rest.

entries.name: Telekinetic
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1. You learn Mage Hand (invisible, +30 feet range). As a Bonus Action, you can shove or pull a creature within 30 feet 5 feet (Strength save).

entries.name: Telepathic
entries.description: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1. You can communicate telepathically within 60 feet. You can cast Detect Thoughts once without a slot per Long Rest.

entries.name: Boon of Fortitude
entries.description: _Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)_ Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Your hit point maximum increases by 40. When you regain hit points, you regain additional hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1).

entries.name: Boon of Recovery
entries.description: _Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)_ Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. When you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can take a Reaction to regain hit points equal to half your hit point maximum (once per Long Rest).

entries.name: Boon of Skill Mastery
entries.description: _Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)_ Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. You gain proficiency in all skills.
